new_string:
/**
 * Everything held about one client, register by register. Its deadline figures
 * come from the one open-deadline list (records/deadlines.ts), so they agree
 * with the Deadlines panel below them, Home and Compliance → Deadlines.
 */
export function clientFile(db: Database, actor: Actor, clientRef: string, today: string = localDate()): ClientFile {
  const client = clientForActor(db, clientRef, actor)
  const o = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM v_client_overview WHERE ref = ?').get(client.ref) as OverviewRow
  const open = openDeadlines(db, actor, { clientRef: client.ref, withinDays: 3650 }, today)
  const overview: ClientOverview = {
    ref: o.ref,
    name: o.client_name,
    category: o.client_category,
    status: o.status,
    companyStatus: o.company_status,
    assignedTo: o.assigned_to,
    activeServices: o.active_services,
    contacts: o.contacts,
    openDeadlines: open.length,
    overdueDeadlines: open.filter((d) => d.days < 0).length,
    nextDueDate: open.find((d) => d.days >= 0)?.due_date ?? null,
